body:
Minor web UX. On the web list view, the header shows a back link "← All lists"
(`web/src/pages/ListPage.tsx:117`, `<Link to="/">`) above the list title `<h1>`
(line 120). The back link works, but the title itself is inert.

The Android app makes the top-bar title tappable → navigates to the Overview
(`ui/Nav.kt:158`, `AppDrawerScaffold(onTitleClick = { navigate(OVERVIEW) })`,
comment: "Tapping the open list's title jumps back to the overview to pick another
list"). Web should match.

Change: make the list-title `<h1>` on the web list view navigate to `/` (overview)
on click, the same target as the existing "← All lists" link (which stays). Keep
the heading's ellipsis/overflow/nowrap styling; add a pointer affordance; keep it a
real heading for a11y while being navigable (e.g. wrap the text in the router
`<Link>`). web-only — no server/android change.
title: Web: clicking the list title returns to the overview (match the app)
